name: zsnd_sample_destroy
description: zSndSample::Destroy runs DestroyOwnedData and frees the sample object.
known_limits: The native smoke validates a heap-owned sample destroy path by absence of allocator/runtime failure; post-free fields are intentionally not inspected.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSound playback class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x4a3910 validate calling zSndSample::DestroyOwnedData and then free(self).
The native smoke allocates a zSndSample with owned marker/name allocations, calls Destroy, and relies on the accepted DestroyOwnedData verifier plus CRT free behavior.
